assets.direction: BAMBOO RIVERSIDE: a quiet jade-green bamboo grove by a small river, layered slender bamboo trunks and foliage clearly visible behind and between the side vendor booths, bamboo and cream vendor fabrics, small warm ivory paper lights in the mid-distance. A low wooden footbridge partly hidden among dense elegant bamboo replaces the distant stone arch; keep its horizon height. Dark teal-green night sky. No tropical palms. Natural pale bamboo, olive and jade atmosphere with warm gold highlights; preserve warm dry wooden foreground. Make the bamboo grove recognizable behind the future central stall.
assets.prompt:

Theme-specific changes must be clearly visible in the MIDDLE region between y=360 and 850 as well as the sky and edges, so small landscape thumbnails look different without any color overlay.

assets.direction: MOONLIT SEASIDE HARBOR: convert distant water into a peaceful deep blue coastal harbor, softly lit small moored fishing boats in the mid-distance and a little pale lighthouse on the far right horizon in place of the old stone bridge. Silver moon reflection in cool blue water. Rope railing remains at the same height; broad dry wooden quay in front remains warm honey brown. Cream/navy side vendor fabrics, a few modest fishing rope details at edges. Dark indigo sky and small bright moon. Calm, elegant navy/ivory maritime environment clearly unlike the green riverside. No beach sand covering the promenade, no water in front of the rail, no large near boats.

assets.direction: AUTUMN MAPLE LANTERN FAIR: rich but restrained amber maple leaves and golden osmanthus foliage frame the edges and mid-distance, low plum/mauve and cream fabric side booths, small warm gold festival lights across the far shore and along the existing railing. A graceful distant garden arch bridge in warm light at the same height. Night sky is a subtle muted plum-indigo, water reflects scattered amber lamps. Some small dry maple leaves on the deck near the side edges only, central floor stays empty and clean. Autumn gold and muted plum setting must be visibly different from the bamboo and navy harbor themes, while wood and food remain naturally colored.
